notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

Registry settings have been moved to cc4.ini file
Videos have been encoded with a more compatible codec
Improved mouse scrolling
Resolution select is now locked to 800x600, 1024x768 and 1280x720
Saves have been moved to game folder for portability
Fixed game crashing when issuing fire or move orders
Fixed game crashing when quickly dragging the mouse to the upper left corner 
Fixed crashes when accessing boot camps
Fixed a possible crash on startup with long directory name or path
Fixed crashes when reading briefings
Fixed crashes when viewing maps
Notes for update (maybe like add on bottom of changelog):
If saves failed to transfer from the previous version, please manually copy them from C:\Users\\Saved Games\Close Combat 4\ to the Games folder in the root directory.
Higher resolutions might break the game design or functionality, if you wish to play at higher resolutions anyway please edit cc4.ini file.

Save files:

gameinstall\Games\Battles\*
gameinstall\Games\Save\*

Best Regards

notes.title: Close Combat 4: The Battle Of The Bulge - build update
notes.content:
We've just released a build update for Close Combat 4 with several improvements, fixes, and changes aimed at enhancing stability and compatibility. Here's what’s new:

Update Changelog:
- Registry settings have been moved to a cc4.ini file.
- Videos re-encoded using a more compatible codec.
- Improved mouse scrolling.
- Resolution selection is now locked to: 800x600, 1024x768, and 1280x720 for optimal performance.
- Save files have been moved to the game folder for portability.
- Fixed crashes when issuing fire or move orders.
- Fixed crash when quickly dragging the mouse to the upper-left corner.
- Fixed crashes when accessing boot camps.
- Fixed crashes when reading briefings. 
- Fixed crashes when viewing maps

Special Notes:

If your saves didn’t transfer automatically, you can manually copy them from:
C:\Users\\Saved Games\Close Combat 4\ to the Games folder in the game’s root directory.

Higher resolutions may cause design or functionality issues. If you want to try the game at a higher resolution anyway, please edit the cc4.ini file.

Thanks for your continued support, and happy commanding!
